Privacy Policy

Last Updated: January 25, 2026

At Jaguar Fitness, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you as to how we look after your personal data when you visit our website.

1. Data We Collect

We collect personal data that you provide to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you provide when you contact us or purchase our products.

2. How We Use Your Data

We use your data to process your orders, provide customer support, and improve our services. We may also use your data to send you marketing communications if you have opted in to receive them.

3. Data Security

We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed.

4. Your Rights

Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to request access to your personal data and the right to request correction of your personal data.

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at privacy@jaguarfitness.com.
